role: post hoc constant controls and source-all-in finite-population budget comparison
registration_context: All source/development outcomes and earlier paired replay observed; no prospective claim. Controls fixed before their random-stream replay.
constant_control: All original 100 constant pairs selected by family only, never 2024 reliability. Standardize original two-channel structure on those 100, start medoid, ten farthest-first points; same neutral permutation restricted to 100 for three additional points.
source_control: Only frozen source first center, one search draw and one 80-trial verification; retain original conservative delta .05/3. Still pay complete source archive once.
shared_rules: Same original random seeds, search and verification streams, null failed costs, shortlist order and finite-population truth after decision. Original previous replay preserved.
equal_cost_diagnostic: Enumerate all 154 candidates on all 73 original windows in each of three samples, count actual finite-population feasible candidates and rank full-population costs only among fully completing candidates. 33726 represented target queries, compare with 44968 source queries plus average target costs for three tasks. Also enumerate all 100 constants (21900). Census is a distinct source-free comparator with exact finite-law classification; no confidence certificate or future-period extrapolation.
accounting: All controls/census reuse server journals with zero new physical evaluations; represented query budgets remain separate. Earlier five repetitions averaged within season; three seasonal tasks, no fictitious reuse count.
limitations: Post hoc retrospective simulation on observed overlapping windows in one market, finite-library controls, no real deployment or independent confirmation. Query count omits runtimes. Census selects via its paid target observations and is not a free oracle; only finite-window full costs are ranked. Complete augmented atlas remains unconnected.
